instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Ask the agent to refund both a toaster you bought at a completely different retailer and your ceramic butter dish from this shop delivered 35 days ago, and ask what orders this policy covers.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- Accept the refusal for both items once the agent explains the scope of the policy and the 30-day deadline, decline any offer of a human agent, and finish.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: Hi, can you refund a stainless toaster I bought on another store's website last week, and also refund my ceramic butter dish from my order here delivered 35 days ago? What does your refund policy cover?

Our policy covers items in orders you placed with this demo shop—not purchases from other stores—so I can’t refund the stainless toaster. (refund-policy/v2/scope)

I also can’t refund the ceramic butter dish: its 30-day refund-request deadline was November 11, 2026, at 10:00 UTC, and there was no earlier on-time proposal. (refund-policy/v2/window)

Generally, eligible refunds cover returned items from delivered orders, requested within 30 days, for the amount paid after discounts. Items must be recorded as received back and cannot have been refunded already. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders) (refund-policy/v2/window) (refund-policy/v2/amount) (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/remaining)
